identificationModule.officialTitle: A Clinical Study on the Safety and Efficacy of BRL-301 (Allogeneic Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cell Injection Targeting CD19 Gene) in the Treatment of Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The study had the following sequential phases: Screening, Pre-Treatment (Cell Product Preparation \& Lymphodepleting Chemotherapy), Treatment and Follow-up.

primaryOutcomes.measure: The safety of BRL-301 in refractory systemic lupus erythematosus
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of AEs and SAEs, including changes in laboratory values, ECG and vital signs as assessed by CTCAE v5.0.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The efficiency of BRL-301 in refractory systemic lupus erythematosus
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of patients with SRI-4 response: including SELENA-SLEDAI ≥4-Point improvement, BILAG 2004 with No new A domain score AND no more than 1 new B domain scores, PGA with No worsening (\<0.3-point increase)
CAR transgene levels by quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) in peripheral blood
